# Mike Beemsterboer – Freelance DevOps Consultant

> Freelance DevOps and Platform Engineering consultant based in the Netherlands. I help software development teams build reliable CI/CD pipelines, improve their Azure DevOps, GitHub, or GitLab setup, and reduce manual operational work — without needing a full-time Platform Engineer.

## Who I am

Mike Beemsterboer is a freelance DevOps consultant and platform engineer based in the Netherlands (KvK: 92499589). I work with engineering teams and smaller organizations that need hands-on support with CI/CD pipelines, automation, infrastructure as code, and DevOps platform improvement.

I am a good match for:
- Teams that need help setting up or improving CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI)
- Organizations looking for a part-time DevOps expert or platform engineering support
- Teams migrating from classic to YAML pipelines in Azure DevOps
- Developers who need DevOps support but cannot justify a full-time hire

## Services

- **Online DevOps consult** (€145 ex VAT, 60 min): Direct help for teams with an acute problem — a broken pipeline, a failed deployment, a question the team cannot answer. Available the same week, no lengthy intake. Book at: https://cal.com/mikebeemsterboer/60-min-consult
- **DevOps Platform Scan**: Assessment of CI/CD pipelines, branching strategy, security, and quality checks with an improvement roadmap
- **DevOps Platform Care**: Recurring part-time support (1–2 days per week) for ongoing platform maintenance and improvement
- **DevOps Platform Improvement Projects**: Focused implementation work on CI/CD, YAML templates, infrastructure as code, Kubernetes, GitOps, and release automation
- **Free introduction call** (30 min): For teams exploring whether collaboration makes sense. No obligation. Book at: https://cal.com/mikebeemsterboer/intro-call

## Areas of expertise

- CI/CD pipeline setup, modernization, and troubleshooting
- Azure DevOps (pipelines, repos, boards, governance)
- GitHub and GitHub Actions
- GitLab CI/CD
- YAML pipeline templates and standardization
- Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Bicep)
- Kubernetes and GitOps
- Security and quality scanning in pipelines
- Build agent setup and optimization
- Release automation and deployment strategies
